chapters.reason: The paper introduces Quiet-STaR, which generates rationales at each token using learnable start and end tokens to steer reasoning, aligning with token-level manipulation without generating full explicit CoT sequences.
The method infers rationales iteratively during training to improve predictions, resembling progressive refinement through step-by-step internalization, unlike one-pass fine-tuning on final answers.
It employs learnable tokens to indicate thought start and end, functioning as a single control mechanism (like pause tokens) to modulate reasoning dynamics uniformly.
